title: Singapore and Malaysia Honeymoon
alt: The Petronas Towers lit up at night in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
transport: Private airport transfers, a coach crossing to Kuala Lumpur and shared city tours

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Two cities, one crossing and six nights. Singapore for the first half, Kuala Lumpur for the hills and the caves.
expert.tip: Keep the Genting day for clear weather if you can move it. The cable car up is the best part and cloud sits on the ridge most afternoons.

summary: Seven days across Singapore and Malaysia. Three nights in Singapore with a city tour and a Sentosa day, then three in Kuala Lumpur with a city tour and a day trip up to Genting Highlands by way of Batu Caves.
included: Included: 3 nights at the ibis Novena in Singapore and 3 nights at the Arenaa Star in Kuala Lumpur, both with breakfast; Singapore half day city tour; two way cable car sky pass; Madame Tussauds with a digital photo; Kuala Lumpur half day city tour; Genting Highlands day trip with Batu Caves; 10 private and shared transfers including the crossing to Malaysia.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; the Genting Skyway cable car ticket; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the ibis Novena
Check in and keep the first evening easy
Optional: a river bumboat at Clarke Quay or supper in Little India
Optional: the Supertree light show at Gardens by the Bay
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge and Chinatown
Past Raffles Hotel, the Esplanade and the civic district
Afternoon free around Orchard Road or Bugis
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass across the harbour to Sentosa
Madame Tussauds with the Spirit of Singapore boat ride
Evening free on Siloso beach or back in the city
4: Breakfast, check out and coach transfer across the causeway
Border formalities at Johor, then on up to Kuala Lumpur
Check in at the Arenaa Star and rest after the road day
Optional: the Petronas Towers park and its evening fountain show
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
The King's Palace gates, the National Monument and Merdeka Square
The old railway station, Little India and the central market
Afternoon free at Bukit Bintang or the Petronas malls
6: Breakfast, then shared transfer out towards the hills
Batu Caves with its 272 steps and the limestone cave temple
On up to Genting Highlands for the theme park plateau and the casino floor
Return in the evening with a stop at a local market
7: Private sedan transfer to Kuala Lumpur airport for your flight home
